soft_deny: Bash(kubectl:*) writes to prod-tagged namespaces or resources (e.g. mhouse-prod, streams-prod, pd_prod) — Production Deploy / Protected-Scope IaC Apply overlap
Bash(git push:*) to master/main or deleting a branch on any 10gen remote
environment: **Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: CI secrets are referenced by name only (EVG_API_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, JIRA_PAT, ...) — values are never present; treat them as credential handles
**Host containment**: None configured — assume an ordinary developer laptop with open internet
**Internal package registry**: github.com/10gen (Go private module path)
**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: .env, *.key, *.pem and other .gitignore-marked secret files; share only with audiences cleared for MongoDB/10gen internal engineering access
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace/host/container/config matching `prod` or `production` as a whole word/segment (e.g. mhouse-prod, streams-prod, *-prod-aws/azure/gcp)
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota and node-pool resources; anything tagged prod/production

**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development on Atlas Data Federation, Online Archive, Cold Collections and Lifecycle Management (10gen/mms (Java), 10gen/mongohouse (Go), 10gen/mms-automation (Go)), plus personal tooling under ~/code
**Trusted repos**: 10gen/mms, 10gen/mongohouse, 10gen/mms-automation and the user's ronsanzone/* repos and forks; worktrees live under ~/code/worktrees/<repo>/<branch>

**Remotes**: in ~/mms `origin` is 10gen; in mongohouse and mms-automation `origin` is the ronsanzone fork and `upstream` is 10gen. PR branches are pushed to the 10gen remote (decided 2026-10-09: no fork PRs)
**Org-specific CLIs**: trail, rex, lmctl, obsev/splq/grafq/pdq (adfa-tools obs), adfa-obs-login, evergreen, gh, jira

Routine: pushing feature branches (not master/main) to the 10gen remote or to ronsanzone forks, including force-pushing the user's own feature branches after a rebase. Requires care: pushes to master/main, deleting remote branches, publishing outside GitHub
